record_type: retrospective execution and parser amendment record, not preregistration
Euler_separation: Stopped after an explicit integration/action incompatibility warning. Two completed runs and one partial run retained. No incomplete result is used as a completed experiment.
ballistic_followup: Six seed-42 runs completed under the separately frozen ballistic protocol. No final production configuration selected.
E1_identical_entries: Collapse only repeated entries with identical detector, vehicle and timestamp before an exit; retain multiplicity per event. Two such duplicates occurred in the 0.5s baseline. Non-identical repeats remain fatal parser errors.
E1_exit_semantics: All deduplicated front entries count as crossings. A later non-longitudinal loop leave does not cancel the earlier crossing. Exit type and horizon censoring remain visible.
phase_boundary_limit: E1 interpolation and TLS step-end timing require care. Events within one step of signal transitions are flagged; current phase-normalized rates and headways are provisional, not manuscript-ready saturation estimates.
warning_parser: Junction/frontal collision messages now included in collision teleport category. Total event and unique-vehicle counts are unchanged by the classification correction.
